problem_type: A run-state concept (has the user confirmed and dispatched this generation) had no owner, so each surface guessed it from a proxy and one node execution state had two renderers
symptom: After the user said 先别生成 and the agent only called draft_shots, the new canvas node showed 排队中 · 第 1/1 and the top-right task button turned blue with 1, which reads as queued and about to spend money. Separately, an agent-dispatched shot rendered 生成中 with an old blurred overlay and big N mark while ordinary nodes use the pixel waiting surface.
direct_cause: deriveShotPlaceholderState mapped any node without a job to queued; buildProductionRunTaskRows grouped every non-terminal run as running; ProductionShotPlaceholder drew its own queued chip, generating overlay and failed card instead of the shared node surfaces.
class_root: Nothing owned the fact whether the current request passed the human spend gate (plan submitted, or a job past authorization_required). The truth existed only inside the batch scheduler, so the placeholder, the task center and the task card each re-derived it from a proxy (job exists, run not terminal, status literal draft), and the production shot kept a second renderer for execution states.
affected_population: Every agent draft created by draft_shots (cardHidden) while the user has not asked to generate
Every priced card waiting for the user, every confirm_all shot waiting on its own gate, every shot unticked from a submitted batch, every draft cancelled before dispatch
Every agent-dispatched shot while queued, generating or failed
entry_points: Canvas node overlay for production shots (ProductionShotPlaceholder / NodeGeneratingOverlay / NodeGenerationStatus / NodeErrorReport)
Top-right task button and task panel production rows
Task card title for a draft-status run
internal_only_reason: The invariant is Nomi's own generation lifecycle (plan state and job status machine in electron/productionRun/productionRunState.ts); no third-party library or external format decides it.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Both processes ask the same question (main for the run summary and scheduler, renderer for canvas and task center) and the renderer may only import the neutral contract layer.

invariants: A node shows queued, generating or stopped only if its shot is in the dispatched scope (plan submitted and shot included) or has a job past the human gate.
A run whose status is draft and whose current request is not dispatched is listed as a draft, never counted as running on the task button.
Queued, generating and failed production shots render through the same node surfaces as ordinary nodes; only the batch-specific stopped state has its own overlay.

door_reduction.why_not: Every remaining door is a reader of the one owner (productionDispatch) or of the single projection built on it (deriveShotPlaceholderState -> projectShotExecution). Readers must exist per surface: the scheduler, the run summary, the canvas node, the shot table, the task button, the task panel and the task card each render a different place. Before this change three independent judges existed (job-exists, not-terminal, authorization_required); now there is one.

generality_proof: All consumers now converge on productionDispatch: the scheduler (jobAwaitsHuman), the run summary (isCurrentRequestDispatched -> ProductionRunSummary.dispatched), the task center and task card (dispatched / isCurrentRequestDispatched), and the canvas (deriveShotPlaceholderState uses jobAwaitsHuman and isNodeInDispatchedScope; useGenerationFeedback and the node error card read projectShotExecution). A new surface that shows run progress has no proxy left to copy: the placeholder no longer returns queued for missing jobs, and the task rows no longer map non-terminal to running.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Owns whether the current request of a run passed the human gate.
Owns whether a node without a job belongs to a dispatched batch.
Single projection of a production shot execution onto the node face read by all node execution surfaces.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Only renders stopped; reads useProductionShotState -> deriveShotPlaceholderState which returns null before dispatch.
Groups by productionRunGroup using ProductionRunSummary.dispatched; mergeProductionRunSummaries computes it with isCurrentRequestDispatched.
Reads jobAwaitsHuman instead of its own authorization_required literal.
Draft vs running title uses isCurrentRequestDispatched.
Projects production shots through useProductionExecutionNode before deriving feedback, so waiting surface, status line and timeline all agree.
Answers a different question (is a priced card waiting for the user), already keyed on plan.state and cardHidden; it does not claim anything is queued or running.

recurrence.reason: Any new surface that shows run progress would have re-derived dispatch from a proxy, and every draft_shots draft, priced card wait, confirm_all shot gate and unticked shot reached the same wrong answer.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs deriveShotPlaceholderState buildProductionRunTaskRows (5 doors before, plus the scheduler literal)
rg "status === 'draft'" src -> productionRunView.ts task card title (now uses the owner)
rg "authorization_required" electron/productionRun -> batchScheduleDerivation.shotInFlight (now uses the owner)
rg "GeneratingOverlay" src -> the center placement had only the production placeholder as caller (removed)

prevention.invariant: Queued, generating, stopped and running are only reported after the user's go-ahead for the current request.
prevention.failure_mode: Before dispatch every surface falls back to showing nothing (null phase, draft group, draft title); it never shows progress.
prevention.strategy: One owner in the neutral contract layer read by main and renderer; the node execution face has a single projection consumed by the shared surfaces; the duplicate renderers and the queued fallback were deleted.

legacy_paths.rationale: Deleted the placeholder queued chip, generating overlay and inline failed card, the center placement of GeneratingOverlay (blur + big N), the no-job queued fallback with queue index and the unused deriveBatchProgress, and the now-unused canvasLanding i18n keys.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls plan or job lifecycle.

migration: No stored data changes. ProductionRunSummary gains a derived boolean computed on read; older snapshots are summarized with the same function.
residual_risks: The canvas batch bar (生成全部 N 个) still reads raw node.status and counts an in-flight agent shot as idle (TODO T-AG-24).
A finished single agent image keeps the task button lit because the run waits for rough-cut review (TODO T-AG-25).
Agent runtime walks on Windows need the unmerged lane identity fix (branch claude/windows-sync-hardening); verified locally with it applied temporarily.
